leads.sub: Nvidia leads the chip rebound; Huang resigned 11 days ago
head: Huang returns to Nvidia,
and Wall Street rallies
leads.deck: The board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive; chip stocks led the gains and the S&P 500 closed 4.7% higher.

leads.sub: ambassadors meet; Polish soil hit on Friday
head: NATO calls an emergency
session on Poland
leads.deck: All 32 ambassadors met after Warsaw said Russian missiles, one of them a Kh-101, came down on Polish soil on Friday.

leads.sub: rescuers found another body on Monday
head: Dymer's toll rises
to eleven dead
leads.deck: Rescuers pulled another body from the rubble of a strike on apartment blocks; the dead include a teenager.

cards.h: The EU proposes a new Russia package
cards.b: The draft cuts 60 banks from SWIFT and adds a sports ban.
The election runner-up, Mundubile, now faces a treason trial.
Moscow says Estonia's move to close the crossing courts open war.

cards.h: A UN worker is killed in Gaza
cards.b: UNRWA names Adel al-Helo, struck near a well.
Treasury hits exchange houses and fronts used to move money.

cards.h: India pledges flood relief to Nepal
cards.b: The money comes as Nepal's new prime minister visits.

cards.h: The factory fire toll rises again
cards.b: The search goes on at the burnt-out candy plant.

cards.h: A drone strikes a police base
cards.b: A baby is among the wounded; 60 homes were damaged.

cards.h: FIFA picks a US-led bid for the Women's World Cup
cards.b: The UK is confirmed as host for 2035.

cards.h: New Zealand hold India to a draw
cards.b: NZ were 239-5 in their second innings, 113 behind.
